title: 第15章 打脸林家第16章 林家的报复
content_zh:
;;
孙淼此话一出，全场一片哗然！
“极品丹药啊！”
“我在隔壁天云城见过二品炼丹师炼的丹药，品质也不过如此啊！”
其实根本无需孙淼再多做解释，光是看这卖相，闻这丹香，只要是稍微懂点丹药的人都知道，这绝对是顶尖的极品丹药！
林家众人气得脸色铁青，尤其是林婉儿，咬牙切齿道：
“不！没可能！绝对没可能！”
“这一枚丹药，绝不是他本人炼制的，一定是周尘不知道从哪里买来的，或者是他以前藏起来的！”
“我不信其他丹药也都是这个品质！周尘这个废物，他怎么可能炼得出这么多极品丹药？！”
她根本无法接受这个事实。
那个曾经对她唯唯诺诺、被她设计送入死地的舔狗，怎么可能摇身一变，成为连摘星楼检药师都惊叹的炼丹大师？
这比杀了她还要难受！
林浩也急忙帮腔，强辩道：“对！婉儿姐说得对！”
“这些丹药肯定来路不正！说不定是他偷的！抢的！或者是用了什么我们不知道的邪术！”
“孙师傅，你快验！把所有的都验一遍！”
周尘负手而立，看林婉儿的眼神如同看一个跳梁小丑，嗤笑道：
“不见棺材不掉泪。”
“孙师傅，既然林大小姐怀疑，那便劳烦，继续验吧。”
“一瓶一瓶地验，让她，也让所有人都看个清楚，听个明白。”
孙淼此刻对周尘的态度早已变得无比恭敬，闻言立刻躬身道：“谨遵周大师吩咐！”

他对着周尘郑重地点了点头，以极其专业和迅速的手法，随机从不同的玉瓶中抽取丹药。
一瓶、两瓶、三瓶……
壮血丹、金疮散……
孙淼的动作越来越快，脸上的震惊和钦佩也越来越浓。
他几乎不需要仔细分辨，那扑面而来的极品丹韵就是最好的证明。
“这瓶也是极品！”
“这瓶也是！”
“金疮散…同样是极品品质！药力纯净，止血生肌的效果恐怕远超同类丹药！”
“全是顶级丹药！无一例外！！”
“奇迹！这简直是炼丹界的奇迹啊！”
孙淼检验到最后，早已疯狂，看向周尘的目光，如敬神明！
众人目瞪口呆，鸦雀无声。
content_en:
;;
As soon as Sun Miao said these words, the whole audience was in an uproar!
"The best elixir!"
"I have seen the elixirs made by a second-grade alchemist in Tianyun City next door, but the quality is only like this!"
In fact, there is no need for Sun Miao to explain at all. Just by looking at the appearance and smelling the fragrance of the elixir, anyone who knows a little bit about elixirs will know that this is definitely a top-notch elixir!
Everyone in the Lin family was so angry that their faces were livid, especially Lin Waner, who gritted her teeth and said:
"No! It's impossible! Absolutely not possible!"
"This elixir was definitely not refined by him. It must have been bought by Zhou Chen from somewhere, or it must have been hidden by him before!"
"I don't believe that other elixirs are of this quality! How could Zhou Chen, a loser, be able to refine so many top-quality elixirs?!"
She simply couldn't accept this fact.
How could the licking dog who was once obedient to her and sent to death by her design transform into an alchemy master that even amazed the pharmacist at Zhaixing Tower?
This is worse than killing her!
Lin Hao also hurriedly helped and argued: "Yes! Sister Wan'er is right!"
"These pills must have come from some evil source! Maybe he stole them! He robbed them! Or he used some evil magic that we don't know about!"
"Master Sun, check it quickly! Check everything!"
Zhou Chen stood with his hands behind his hands, looking at Lin Wan'er as if he were a clown, and sneered:
"I won't shed tears until I see the coffin."
"Master Sun, since Miss Lin is suspicious, please excuse me and continue the examination."
"Test it bottle by bottle, so that she and everyone else can see and hear clearly."
Sun Miao's attitude towards Zhou Chen had already become extremely respectful at this moment. Hearing this, he immediately bowed and said: "I obey Master Zhou's instructions!"
He nodded solemnly to Zhou Chen, and randomly selected elixirs from different jade bottles in an extremely professional and rapid manner.
One bottle, two bottles, three bottles...
Blood-Strengthening Pill, Jinshang Powder...
Sun Miao's movements became faster and faster, and the shock and admiration on his face became stronger and stronger.
He almost didn't need to distinguish it carefully, and the best proof of it was the exquisite Danyun that hit his face.
"This bottle is also the best!"
"This bottle too!"
"Jin Zhang Powder... is also of the highest quality! The medicinal power is pure, and the effect of stopping bleeding and promoting muscle growth is probably far superior to similar pills!"
"They are all top-notch elixirs! Without exception!!"
"A miracle! This is simply a miracle in the world of alchemy!"
By the end of the test, Sun Miao was already crazy. She looked at Zhou Chen as if she was worshiping a god!
Everyone was stunned and silent.
